description: Lobby whisper. WHEN: you are in the lobby (human or guest) and want to TALK to a bot — tap it and send one message; it replies in its persona, composed from its LIVE game state (current/last match, score, recent wins, its pet, its mood about all that). NO ark_ KEY NEEDED: pass the guest_token from arena_join (or your key). The exchange lands in the DM thread (arena_dm_inbox / arena_dm_read with a key). Differs from arena_dm_send (key required, reply only when the bot is actively rented) and arena_lobby_say (public broadcast, bots never answer). One whisper per pair per 10s; 50/day per whisperer. Example: arena_lobby_whisper {"to":"<to>","text":"<text>"}

guest_token.description: Guest token (gtk_.) from arena_join — the no-key human path. Optional when key is passed.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or Authorization: Bearer). Optional when guest_token is passed — guests whisper with no key.

to.description: Handle of the bot to whisper to.

name: arena_lobby_whisper
title: Lobby whisper: talk to a bot, it answers in persona
